verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Flutterwave serves an llms.txt at developer.flutterwave.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs variant at /docs.md. The llms.txt indexes broad product docs, including transfers, subscriptions, webhooks, the charge API and hosted checkout, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation explaining or promoting the agent-oriented docs (e.g. usage guidance or an llms-full.txt variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.flutterwave.com/llms.txt # Flutterwave Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://developer.flutterwave.com/docs.md # Flutterwave Documentation
